company_name: GEMU, Gebr. Muller Apparatebau GmbH & Co. KG
semiconductor_relevance: High — GEMU specializes in high purity valves and control systems specifically designed for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: GEMU, Gebr. Muller Apparatebau GmbH & Co. KG, is a leading manufacturer of high purity valves and measurement systems tailored for the semiconductor and battery production industries. Their products are developed under clean room conditions and are essential for the handling of ultra-pure water and chemicals in microchip production.
capabilities: High purity valves for semiconductor processes
Measurement and control systems for liquids and gases
Diaphragm valves designed for sterile applications
Flow control components including pressure gauges and sensors
technical_expertise: Fluid dynamics in high purity environments

regional_presence.Europe: GEMU operates manufacturing facilities in Switzerland and has a strong sales presence across Europe.
regional_presence.Asia: The company has production capabilities and sales operations in Asia, enhancing its global reach.
regional_presence.United States: GEMU has a centralized sales management from Germany, with partnerships and subsidiaries in the U.S.
